name: Wau Bulan Workshop Display
summary: Original static display of a Malaysian crescent-tail kite with layered paper and bowed bamboo spars.
description: Original Kelantan-inspired moon kite on a bamboo workshop cradle, with a separate crescent tail, invented paper applique, bowed rear spars and a paired cotton bridle. A static art prop, not a historic replica or a flight-tested design.
author: Blender-3D-Gallery original procedural modeling
creation_method: Original mesh geometry with constrained-Delaunay curved paper laminate, layered cut-paper shapes, physical bamboo frame and cotton bridle. Native Cycles render.
rights: Original project asset; redistribution terms for public downloads are not specified.
accuracy_notes: Static artwork, no replica, manufacturer, flight, instruction or certification claim. The station and invented motif are original. Blender +Z up, -Y outward; glTF +Y up, +Z outward; metres.

attribution.credit: Original geometry, ornament and images authored in Blender; no external artwork, crest, font, banknote image or geometry reused.
